6557.title: Launcher hand-off recursion is already guarded on main
6557.rootCauseOneLine: Historical app-entry delegation repeatedly honored a launcher-valued BB_CLI; main now marks the first hand-off and bypasses that override on re-entry.

prReviews.topFinding: The marker handshake terminates the launcher cycle; verified in two clean source checkouts.

6557.proposedFix: No additional fix: preserve the landed guard and existing regression from #6436.
6557.caveats: Linux source-main verification, not the released macOS build; extreme memory usage was not recreated.
